# Test RN App

This guide aims to detail some ways in which you can test your RN apps with SeaTalk. This process is more suitable for testing your app after majority of development is finished, and the app is ready to be tested. This is because it is closer to simulating how your app will be loaded in SeaTalk in production. For testing during development, please refer [Develop RN App](/docs/develop-rn-app)

# Prepare RN App Bundle

You have just finished development, and want to test your app. Follow these steps to easily load and preview your apps in SeaTalk iOS/Android clients.

1. Bundle your app to get your`.stb`file. For more info on how to do this, refer to [CLI Tool](/docs/rn-sdk-apis_cli-tools).
2. Host your`.stb`file in a place that your native app can access, to download this file later on.**Note**: Use python to [help you out](https://stackabuse.com/serving-files-with-pythons-simplehttpserver-module/)with easy file hosting

From this point on, the steps will vary slightly depending on whether you are using the SeaTalk Android or iOS app. Both instructions are listed, so make sure you refer to the correct one for you.

# Test RN App on SeaTalk Mobile App

## For iOS

1. Navigate to the Forbidden Zone on your SeaTalk app (by overturning your phone), and enter the React Native Settings page![](data:image/png;base64,)
2. Use the Remote Resource load feature to download your .stb file. Enter the URL of your .stb file in the appropriate place, then press download.![](data:image/png;base64,)
3. Once your resources are downloaded, all you have to do is to enter the appropriate`AppID/ModuleName`and pass in any props your require, and hit Enter. This should take you to your corresponding RN page, should everything be set up correctly.![](data:image/png;base64,)

## For Android

1. Flip over the phone (or tap on the bug button in login screen) to launch the debug page, and tap**React Native**to launch the React Native settings.![](data:image/png;base64,)
2. Turn on**Remote Package**![](data:image/png;base64,)
3. Fill in`App ID`,`Entry Module`and`Bundle URL`, then tap**Load Remote Package**.![](data:image/png;base64,)
4. Make sure`Skip Loading`is checked (it will be checked if the loading is successful; a toast will be shown). Tap**Start RN Activity**.![](data:image/png;base64,)
5. Happy testing! If you face any issues during this flow, please contact us to help you resolve your issues.
